task.title: [M5] Walk compilation and independent multilayer regression verification
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M5
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M5-04
**Implementation status:** Backlog (to-do); planned only, no implementation or verification claimed. Kaneo column is authoritative if later changed.
**Responsible implementer:** Unassigned. Required skill: Authorized engineer for this bounded deliverable; independent reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§6/M5 acceptance, 7, 14
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Prove the M4 Walk composition compiles correctly before native acceptance.

**Scope:** Synthetic Walk image-to-compiler exercise, Rust canonical verification and Novice/Orc regressions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Use a synthetic legally distributable test monster with Walk action/views/frames/layers declared before art, exact PNG assignments and operator-approved composition.
- [ ] Compile through production pipeline twice, compare output hashes and independently decode ordered layers/image mapping/timing/anchors with Rust.
- [ ] Reconstruct real Orc Skeleton multilayer package without losing 12-layer death motion or transformed placement; bounded Novice replacement leaves unrelated slots/head unchanged.
- [ ] Record requirements/assignment/composition snapshot, output hashes, structural/coverage and oracle results; missing private fixtures are NOT_RUN and do not erase their regression requirement.
- [ ] One-view or smaller-than-runtime scope stays diagnostic/incomplete for full profile; structural/oracle PASS cannot claim native Walk proof.

## Verification

Reproduce synthetic bounded Walk end-to-end build/oracle comparison and private optional Novice/Orc regressions; capture commands/versions/statuses/hashes.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-25 (M5-03; task ID udjjt7jp22k3owbo05s8mnf8); RSF-5 (M0-05; task ID dpexmlk6wggb1xri9yefzjnq)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Native runtime claim belongs to M5-05, no automatic visual decisions.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Not implemented by this planning sync.
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: NOT_RUN (planning only).
- Milestone gates / limitations: Not evaluated; structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

Not performed for implementation. Implementer supplies evidence and moves to QA Review; a distinct read-only reviewer records QA_PASS / QA_FAIL / QA_BLOCKED. Operator-only visual/native decisions remain separate. No acceptance is granted by backlog creation.
